issue: An initial metadata-display probe assumed the previous nested artifact wrapper; b1fc instead preserves the raw GitHub artifact object and a separate downloader receipt. The display probe stopped with KeyError: artifact before inspecting ZIP members.
resolution: A new standard-library stage driver reads the two original records directly and compares actual ZIP size/SHA, GitHub digest/size/head and downloader path/id/size/SHA. It invokes existing source/reference checks once per applicable scope; prior review code is unchanged.
